text:
Maya (CSM): Quick ask — Acme is going live next week. Need a concise customer-facing one-pager: cache priming, safe batching defaults, streaming fallback, 3 quick health checks, and top renewal-risk signals. Keep it paste-ready.

Ravi (CS Ops): Drafting now. Will keep each section 1-2 lines.

Nora (SRE): Short SRE bullets: interactive batch <=20ms, background 100-200ms, fallback when queue_depth >200, route to quantized variant on GPU error.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll include a tiny YAML snippet and a curl healthcheck.

Ravi (CS Ops): RUNBOOK (paste to customer)
PRE-FLIGHT (48h) - Verify API keys & scopes; run 10 warm calls to surface cold starts; upload top-15 prompt prefixes to seed cache; lock model version.
GO-LIVE (first 60m) - Interactive: max_wait_ms=20, max_tokens_batch=1024; Background: max_wait_ms=150, max_tokens_batch=8192; enable prefix caching; start 15m warm pool.
HEALTH CHECKS (every 5m) - P95 latency < SLA; error rate <1%; token throughput ~expected. If latency spikes, reduce batch window or shift to lower-capacity variant.
FALLBACKS - If queue_depth>200 -> enable streaming single-token flush; on GPU OOM -> auto-route to quantized model-variant; send short customer update: "Switching to safe path, will update in 15m."
RENEWAL SIGNALS (watch) - Usage drop >30% WoW post-onboard; repeated timeouts or quality complaints; no enablement activity after 2 weeks. Flag CSM for outreach.
FEEDBACK (simple) - Daily 3-question form (latency, accuracy, recommend: yes/neutral/no); automated eval run every 12h; if accuracy delta >8% -> open ticket tagged renewal-risk.
OWNERS & ESCALATION - Tier1: Maya (CSM) - customer comms; Tier2: Sam (Solutions Eng) - infra/config; Tier3: Nora (SRE) - incidents/routing.
ACTIONS - Maya: send runbook + request seed prompts by EOD Thu; Sam: add YAML to repo & confirm model pin; Nora: schedule 30m preflight.

Sam (Solutions Eng): YAML (drop into infra repo):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: interactive
    max_wait_ms: 20
    max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
    caching: prefix
fallbacks:
  - condition: queue_depth > 200
    action: enable_streaming_single_token
  - condition: gpu_failure
    action: route_to: model-quant-v2
```

Nora (SRE): HEALTHCHECK CURL:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"health-check","route":"interactive"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
Expect 200 + latency header.

RunBot: Deployment event: acme-infra warm pool started at 1747440015.

Maya (CSM): This is perfect. I'll paste into kickoff email and follow up after 24h.
